visual_direction: Original stylized fantasy MMORPG character; charming anime-inspired proportions; elevated semi-isometric readability.
identity: Older adult adventurer shown with dignity, experience, warmth, confidence, capability and intelligence.
silhouette: walking staff, cane, sword, spear, magical staff, merchant cane or travel umbrella
layered cloak, mantle, shawl, robe, long coat or weathered cape
distinctive hairstyle, beard, hat, hood, spectacles or large collar
one asymmetric detail such as shoulder mantle, satchel, old pauldron, bandaged arm, tool belt or ceremonial charm
face: silver gray white or salt-and-pepper hair
optional neat gray beard or tied-back hair

animation_notes.idle: slow breathing, subtle weight shift, adjusts cloak or gloves, rests one hand on staff, calmly observes
animation_notes.walk: controlled short experienced steps; staff touches ground just before each step
animation_notes.talk: thoughtful hand gestures, small nods, warm expression
animation_notes.greeting: briefly straightens and confidently raises hand or staff
animation_notes.combat: briefly straightens and moves with surprising precision and speed
animation_notes.hurt: small recoil followed by rapid recovery; never helpless
animation_notes.victory: calm nod, relaxed posture, weapon or staff lowered

technical.pipeline: Blender -> Substance 3D Painter -> GLB/GLTF -> Godot 4 Forward+
technical.test_camera: Honour War elevated semi-isometric gameplay camera

negative_constraints: no existing game character or copied costume/hair/icon
